From github: https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/12388.
What is the user problem or growth opportunity you want to see solved?
When I am trying to open any site in private mode which has respective app installed it shows a message to open in app however clicking on cancel does not allow to browse the site in browser. Like other browser the links should open normally in browser in private mode even through app is installed. If user wants he/she can click open in app after page loads. Please implement this feature... Too much irritating.
How do you know that this problem exists today? Why is this important?
Asking a user to open in app and not allowing to browse simply defeat the purpose of private mode
Who will benefit from it?
All users
